question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this first-class iOS Tailscale/MagicDNS onboarding path after it is rebased onto the current onboarding refresh and fixed for branded typography?
rationale: The PR is a feature-level onboarding/security decision, not only a mechanical bug fix, and it has a protected maintainer label plus a live merge conflict with current main.

options.title: Sponsor After Rebase
options.body: Ask the author or a maintainer to rebase onto current main, preserve current setup-code route handling, fix branded typography, and continue review of the secure Tailscale path.

options.title: Fold Into Existing Work
options.body: Close or supersede this branch only if maintainers decide the merged onboarding refresh and related public pairing issues should own the remaining direction instead.

options.title: Narrow The PR
options.body: Keep only the auth-copy and raw-IP-blocking pieces if the full connection-path chooser is too broad for the current iOS onboarding direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor After Rebase
